text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, 
what is that over there...?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Merchant
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, folks! The New Year's 
Grand Raffle is in full swing~! 
Grand prize is none other than a 'Hot 
Springs Vacation Voucher'!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Merchant
text_block_list.text:
"1st prize is a 'Special Carrot Salisbury 
Steak'! 
2nd prize is a 'Carrot Mountain'! 
3rd prize is '1 Carrot'!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Merchant
text_block_list.text:
"Come one, come all, test your luck! 
Anyone can enter~!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It really is a raffle...! 
Oh, my..."
choice_data_list: Curious?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever New Year's had clear skies, 
it was a tradition to draw raffles in town 
with my mother—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
""Mother! 
I won a Siberian husky plushie! 
It is so very cute...!""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
""...I shall guard the fields for you, 
Mother, woof! 
Command me as you wish, woof! 
...Just kidding.""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""...Hehe. Is that so...? 
Then perhaps I will have him guard your 
bedroom instead. 
So that you can cuddle him whenever you 
like...""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Like this—hup!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ""Eek! Mother... hehehe!""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —...Hehe.
choice_data_list:
...Here, we got this ticket from our 
shopping earlier.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh—ah, come to think of it...
choice_data_list:
Let's win something nice and let your 
mother know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matching our breathing, 
Daring Tact and I turned the handle of the 
lottery wheel together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Merchant
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa! Congraaaatulaaations!! 
We have a Grand Prize winner! 'Hot Springs 
Vacation Voucher'~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Obtained [<itemname>]

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Incredible, it's the grand prize, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's call your mother right away!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""—My... isn't that wonderful? 
That's my Tact. Strong, gentle... 
and gifted with good fortune, too.""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe... 
Thank you very much."
choice_data_list: Daring Tact, I can hold the phone for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""So, when are you going to the hot 
springs? 
Are you quite busy right now, I 
wonder...?""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Well... the Senior Year has 
only just begun, after all..."
choice_data_list:
Probably best to focus on races for a 
while... right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""I see... Taking your time to relax 
properly 
once things settle down sounds lovely, 
too.""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""Trainer... if you wouldn't mind, 
would you accompany her?""
choice_data_list: Me, ma'am?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""Yes. It would be difficult for me to 
go... 
and Tact feels most at ease 
with you by her side, Trainer.""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"If that is all right with you... 
I would be honored if you joined me."
choice_data_list: Understood, let's go together.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""Tact. I am always, always 
watching your races. Do your best this 
year as well.""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Thank you so much! 
I will do my absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...All right, Trainer. 
Let's tackle the Senior Year with 
everything we've got!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Speaking with her mother fired Daring Tact 
up even further. 
We decided to save the grand prize hot 
springs trip 
for when our schedule finally calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Merchant
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations, 1st prize~! 
Your prize is a 'Special Carrot Salisbury 
Steak'!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Obtained [<itemname>]

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"What a delightfully large Salisbury 
steak. 
It looks delicious...!"
choice_data_list:
Awesome, let's get it cooked back at the 
academy!

Nice, let's get it cooked back at the 
academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After letting her mother know the news, 
we returned to the academy and had the 
Salisbury steak cooked up for us.
choice_data_list: Smells incredible...!
Smells incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, it truly does. 
It certainly whets the appetite."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Before that, though... a toast.
choice_data_list: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we partake?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact took up her knife and fork. 
As she sliced into the meat patty... 
she carved it apart with quiet, exquisite 
grace.
choice_data_list:
(Whoa, her table manners are 
impeccable...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm... The carrot glacé 
has such a beautifully defined sweetness."
choice_data_list: (I-Is this a high-end dinner party?!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The savory juices spread throughout your 
mouth... 
It is truly delicious, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: A-Ah, yeah... It really is delicious!
Y-Yeah, mm... It really is delicious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instinctively straightening my posture, 
I took a bite of the steak. 
It felt almost as if I were dining at an 
upscale restaurant...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Merchant
text_block_list.text:
"2nd prize~~!! 
Your reward is a 'Carrot Mountain'!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Obtained [<itemname>]

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"So very many... 
Whatever should we do with them?"
choice_data_list: We could hand them out to everyone, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Concerns over viral infections were still 
lingering. 
Gathering a huge crowd together right now 
probably wasn't the best idea. Which 
meant—
choice_data_list: If only we could do something online...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Online... 
If that's the case—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, everyone. This is Daring Tact. 
How are you all doing today?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, 'A stream is so rare for you!'. 
Thank you for your comment."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Today we received a bountiful supply of 
carrots, 
so I thought I would cook up a variety of 
dishes with them."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Wherever you may be watching from, 
please sit back and enjoy."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
""What's your favorite dish?"...Let me 
see... 
I am fond of simple, rustic home-cooking 
where the natural quality of the 
ingredients truly shines through."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... "I'm cooking along with you, 
Tact!". 
Hehe, thank you so much."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact's cooking stream proceeded 
warmly and smoothly. 
I had no doubt her mother back home 
was watching over her fondly as well.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Merchant
text_block_list.text:
"3rd prize~! 
Your prize is '1 Carrot'!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Obtained [<itemname>]

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Just... one carrot, is it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Then let's turn this one carrot... 
into the most delicious one yet.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—When roasting, temperature control is 
everything. 
You have to observe its shape, 
then roll it slowly so the heat spreads 
evenly throughout.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Slow and steady... patiently, with utmost 
care...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...When she finished roasting it 
and cut off a bite-sized piece for me... 
a rich, comforting sweetness bloomed 
across my tongue.
choice_data_list: T-This is incredible...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm so glad. 
Well then, I'll have a bite as well...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm, so good! It's absolutely perfect. 
I'll have to roast one for Mother someday 
too.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Aw, too bad! You didn't win! 
Here's a pack of tissues as a consolation 
prize~

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: A miss, huh...
A miss, huh...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Tissues are practical, at least, 
so I'm grateful for that, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
What will I 
tell Mother...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I tell her I lost, 
she might feel disappointed...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I always want to bring her 
happy news from my daily life, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Caring so deeply about her mother, 
Daring Tact fell deep into thought...
